info.title: Granite Manager API
info.description: JSON API behind Granite Manager, a CRM for countertop and stone fabrication companies. Every request acts as the signed-in user and only sees data of that user's company.

get.description:
Returns the user behind the session, including their permission flags and
the company every other request acts in.

Returns the position ids (job roles such as sales rep) the user holds in
the company the request acts in.

200.description: Position ids in the current company

get.description:
Returns the amount the signed-in user aims to sell each month, or null
when they have not set one. Set it with `PUT /v1/me/sales-goal`.

200.description: The goal, null when not set

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

put.description:
Saves the amount the signed-in user aims to sell each month (USD, above 0,
rounded to cents) and returns it as saved.

400.description: The amount is not above 0 or too large

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns whether the signed-in user's Telegram is linked to the lead alerts
bot and to the notifications bot, and the bots' ids for the Telegram login
widget. When a bot is configured, the saved link is checked with Telegram
first; a link Telegram rejects (bot blocked, chat gone) is removed and
reported as not linked, so the user is asked to connect again.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns every non-deleted customer of the caller's company, optionally
filtered by sales rep. Invalid leads are hidden unless `show_invalid=1`.
With `view=companies` it returns only customers that have a company name,
each with revenue and project totals. Rows carry the primary email only;
use `POST /v1/customers/emails/batch` for all addresses.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
`customers` (default) lists every customer. `companies` lists only
customers with a company name and adds revenue and project totals.
Any other value is treated as `customers`.

parameters.name: sales_rep
parameters.description:
Only customers assigned to this sales rep (a user id, see
`GET /v1/users/sales-reps`). Omit or leave empty for all reps.

parameters.name: show_invalid
parameters.description:
`1` also returns leads marked invalid. Ignored when `view=companies`,
which never filters invalid leads out.

200.description: Customer rows, or company rows when `view=companies`

400.description: `sales_rep` is not an integer

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Saves a customer with its addresses (an address of another customer is
refused). Without a sales rep, a sales rep creating a customer (other
than a walk-in) becomes its rep. An assigned customer gets an open deal
and an audit line; the telephony address books are updated.

400.description: Missing name, unknown source or sales rep

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

409.description: An address belongs to another customer

post.summary: Get all emails of several customers
post.description:
Returns every email address of the given customers, primary address
first, keyed by customer id. Customers without emails, and ids belonging
to another company, are absent from the result.

200.description: Map of customer id to email addresses, primary first

400.description: More than 20000 ids, or a malformed body

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns up to 15 live customers matching `term` by name (typos
tolerated, also matches the company name), phone digits, any email, or
company name. Customers with a live deal of the caller come first, then
the caller's own customers, then the best text matches. Each row carries
every email and the customer's latest deal. Fetch one in full with
`GET /v1/customers/{id}`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: What the user typed. Required (may be empty for phone search).

parameters.name: own_only
parameters.description: `true` returns only customers assigned to the caller or unassigned.

400.description: Missing `term` or unknown `by`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns a customer of the caller's company with contact details, every
email address (primary first), the assigned sales rep and the lead form
answers. 404 for other companies' customers, and for deleted ones unless
`include_deleted=true` (a deal page still shows its deleted customer).

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Also return the customer when it was deleted.

400.description: Malformed query

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such customer in the caller's company

put.description:
Saves the contact details, source and addresses (exactly `emails`, the
first one primary). A new sales rep is recorded in the audit trail (with
the sales manager's original assignment of a lead first), stamps the
first assignment date, and gets the open deal.

400.description: Missing name, unknown source or sales rep

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such live customer in the company

409.description: An address belongs to another customer

delete.description:
Hides the customer (soft delete) and removes it from the telephony
address books. A customer with live deals needs `cascade_deals=true`,
which hides the deals too. Admins and sales managers only.

parameters.name: cascade_deals
parameters.description: Also delete the customer's live deals (required when it has any).

403.description: Caller is neither an admin nor a sales manager

404.description: No such live customer in the company

409.description: The customer has live deals and `cascade_deals` is not set

put.description:
Records the change in the audit trail, stamps the first assignment
date, gives the rep the open deal and two reminders (text within a
day, check within three).

400.description: Unknown sales rep

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such live customer in the company

put.description: `hot`, `medium` or `cold`, or null to clear it.

400.description: Unknown temperature

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such live customer in the company

put.description:
Records why the lead is invalid, unassigns it and hides its live deals
(each deletion audited). Admins and sales managers only.

400.description: Missing reason

403.description: Caller is neither an admin nor a sales manager

404.description: No such live customer in the company

get.description:
The customer dialog's history: creation and assignment, deals (live,

recording drips that were sent but are missing from it) and the
activities and notes of the live deals. Deleted customers included.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such customer in the company

The live customers of the family the customer belongs to (its parent and

400.description: A customer cannot be its own parent

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns the non-deleted users of the caller's company who hold the sales

get.summary: List the company's stones with slab availability
get.description:
Returns the stones of the caller's company that are on display (admins may
add hidden ones with `include_hidden=true`), sorted by name, each with counts of its slabs in the yard (`slabs`). Sold out stones
(no available slab and not regular stock) are hidden unless
`include_sold_out=true`; hidden and deleted stones are never returned.
Filters combine with AND; list filters take the parameter repeated and
match any value. Color ids come from the colors list, supplier ids from
the suppliers list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only stones of these types, e.g. `granite`, `quartz`, `marble`.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only stones bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: color_id
parameters.description: Only stones tagged with at least one of these colors (color ids).

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Only stones of these price levels (1 = cheapest ... 7).

parameters.name: finishing
parameters.description: Only stones with these surface finishes: `polished`, `leathered`, `honed`.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out stones: no available slab and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description:
`true` also returns stones hidden from the catalogs (`is_display`
false). Admins only (403 otherwise). Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin, or asks for hidden stones without being an admin

post.description:
Creates a stone of the caller's company with its image (an upload to the
`stones` folder, thumbnail made here) and colors. Add its slabs with
`POST /v1/stones/{id}/slabs`.

400.description: Missing name or image, unknown type, supplier or color, bad finishing, level, size or date

403.description: Caller is not an admin

get.summary: Search the company's stones by name
get.description:
Returns up to `limit` stones whose name contains `name`, best matches
first (name starts with it, then contains it as a word), each with the
same fields and slab counts as `GET /v1/stones`. By default only
displayed stones that are regular stock or have an available whole slab;
see `include_sold_out` and `include_hidden`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Part of the stone name, case-insensitive. Empty returns no stones.

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out stones. By default a stone is listed
when it is regular stock or has an available whole slab.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description:
`true` also returns stones hidden from the catalog (`is_display`
false). Default `false`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most stones to return, 1 to 50. Default 25.

400.description: A parameter has the wrong type

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.summary: Add a stone with its slabs in one step
post.description:
Creates a displayed stone and either one leftover slab (bundle
`LO-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`) or one slab per bundle label, all with the given
size. Used while selling a slab that is not in the system yet. Returns
the stone and the new slab ids, ready to put on a sale.

400.description: Missing name, non-positive price, negative size, unknown stone type, or no bundles

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns every field of a stone of the caller's company, including hidden
(not displayed) stones, plus the ids of its colors. Deleted stones and
stones of other companies are 404. List its slabs with
`GET /v1/stones/{id}/slabs`.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

put.description:
Saves every field of the body on a stone of the caller's company and
replaces its colors. With a new `image_url` the image is replaced and the
old file deleted; without one the image is kept.

400.description: Invalid field (see `create_stone`)

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

parameters.name: include_slabs
parameters.description:
`true` also hides the stone's slabs in the yard. Without it, a stone
that still has slabs is not deleted (409).

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

409.description: The stone has slabs and `include_slabs` is not set

get.description:
Returns the slabs and remnants in the yard for a stone: its own plus
those of the stones it draws from (linked stones, marked with
`source_stone`). Cut and deleted slabs are left out. Sold slabs carry
their sale (customer, seller, date, notes, room, sinks); remnants carry
the sale of the slab they were cut from. Ordered by slab id; group by
`bundle` for display. Sell an available slab with the sales routes,
resize one with `PATCH /v1/slabs/{id}`.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

post.summary: Add a slab to a stone
post.description:
Adds a slab in the yard with a bundle label, a size (the stone's size
when length and width are 0 or missing) and an optional photo (an upload
to the `stones` folder).

400.description: Empty bundle, negative size, or a photo URL that is not an upload

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns the live stones of the caller's company that have installed
photos (`has=images`) or slabs in the yard (`has=slabs`), by name: the
choices for linking photos or slabs.

parameters.name: has
parameters.description: `images` or `slabs`: only stones that have some.

schema.description: What a stone must have to be listed by `GET /v1/stones/names`.

400.description: Missing or unknown `has`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns the stones this one draws slabs from, the stones that draw slabs
from it, and the stones whose photos it shows, each by name.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns the stone's own installed (project) photos, by id, then those of
the stones it links photos from, by stone name (marked with
`source_stone`).

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

post.summary: Add installed photos to a stone
post.description:
Saves uploads (`POST /v1/uploads`, folder `stones`) as installed photos
of the stone and stores their thumbnails. Returns the new photos.

400.description: No URLs, more than 50, or a URL that is not an upload

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

delete.description: Deletes one of the stone's own photos and its stored file.

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such photo on this stone of the caller's company

post.summary: Show another stone's photos on this stone
post.description:
Links the installed photos of `source_stone_id` (same company) to the
stone: they appear in `GET /v1/stones/{id}/images`. Linking twice is a
no-op.

400.description: Unknown source stone, or the stone itself

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

delete.description:
Removes the photo link from `source_stone_id`; its photos stay on that
stone.

204.description: Unlinked (also when there was no link)

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

post.description:
Links `source_stone_id` (same company): its slabs count as this stone's
(lists, slabs dialog, sales). A stone cannot draw from itself or from a
stone that already draws from it. Linking twice is a no-op.

400.description: Unknown source stone, the stone itself, or a reverse link exists

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

delete.summary: Stop drawing slabs from another stone
delete.description:
Removes the slab link: the source stone's slabs no longer count as this
stone's. Sales already made are not touched.

204.description: Unlinked (also when there was no link)

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such stone in the caller's company

get.summary: List the company's sink models with free units
get.description:
Returns the non-deleted sink models of the caller's company, sorted by
name, each with the number of units free to sell (`available`). Models
not on display are included (`is_display`). Sold out models (no free unit
and not regular stock) are hidden unless `include_sold_out=true`. Filters
combine with AND; `type` takes the parameter repeated and matches any value.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only sink models of these types: `stainless 18 gauge`, `stainless 16 gauge`,
`composite`, `ceramic`, `farm house`. Repeat the parameter for several.

parameters.name: supplier_id
parameters.description: Only sink models bought from this supplier (a supplier id).

parameters.name: include_sold_out
parameters.description:
`true` also returns sold out models: no free unit and not regular
stock. Default `false`.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description:
`true` returns only models with at least one free unit, even regular
stock ones without units (what can be installed on a sale right now).
Overrides `include_sold_out`. Default `false`.

400.description: A filter has the wrong type, e.g. `supplier_id=abc`

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Creates a sink model of the caller's company with its image (an upload
to the `sinks` folder; the thumbnail is made here) and, with `units`,
that many units in stock.

400.description: Missing name or image, unknown type or supplier, negative price, size or units

403.description: Caller is not an admin

get.description:
Returns a live sink model of the caller's company with its unit counts
(`units` includes the `installed_units` on sales).

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such model in the caller's company

Saves the fields of a sink model of the caller's company. A new
`image_url` replaces the image (the old file is deleted). With `units`,
free units are added or removed to reach that total; units installed on
sales are never removed (400 when `units` is below them).

400.description: Invalid field, or `units` below the installed units

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such model in the caller's company

403.description: Caller is not an admin

delete.description: Deletes the photo and its stored file.

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such photo on this model of the caller's company

delete.description: Deletes the photo and its stored file.

get.description:
Returns the slabs of the caller's company among the given ids (others are
left out), each with its bundle label and its stone (id, name, type).
Use it to label slabs already chosen on a sale.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Slab ids to return; repeat the parameter (`?id=1&id=2`). Required:
without ids the list is empty.

400.description: An id is not a number

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

delete.description:
Removes a slab of the caller's company from the yard (soft delete: it
disappears from every list).

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such slab in the caller's company

patch.summary: Change a slab's size or number
patch.description:
Sets the length and width (inches, both positive, sent together) and/or
the bundle label of one slab or remnant of the caller's company. Returns
no body; reload the stone's slabs (`GET /v1/stones/{id}/slabs`) to see it.

400.description: Nothing to change, only one of length/width, a non-positive size, or an empty bundle

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such slab in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns the sale's customer, seller, notes, price and its rooms, each with
the slabs used (`is_full` false when only part of a slab was sold), the
sinks and faucets installed, and the room options. 404 when the sale is
not the company's or no slab is left on it. Save changes with
`PUT /v1/sales/{id}`.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such sale with slabs in the caller's company

put.description:
Replaces the sale's customer, notes, price, rooms, slabs, sinks and
faucets with the body (the seller only when `seller_id` is given). Slabs
may be ones the sale already has or available ones; slabs left out are
freed, with their sinks and faucets. All or nothing.

400.description: Invalid body (see `create_sale`)

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such sale in the caller's company

post.description:
Creates a pending sale dated now. Each room needs square feet and at least
one available slab of the company; a slab sold partially
(`is_full: false`) leaves a remnant in the yard, and a slab used in
several rooms gets a piece cut from it for each later room. Sinks and
faucets take one free unit of each model, installed on the room's first
slab. A customer without a sales rep gets the seller. All or nothing: any
error leaves the data unchanged.

400.description: Invalid body: no rooms, a room without slabs or square feet, unknown customer/slab/model, a slab already sold, or no free unit of a sink/faucet model

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Marks the sale cancelled, frees its slabs and the sinks and faucets on
them, and removes the free remnants its partial slabs left. Remnants that
another sale bought are kept. Returns no body.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

404.description: No such sale in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns every supplier of the caller's company, by name. Stones, sinks and
faucets refer to them by `supplier_id`.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns every color a stone can be tagged with (the same list for all
companies), by name. Stones carry them as `color_ids`.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

get.description:
Returns the materials stones of the company can have (`granite`,
`quartz`...), by name. A stone's `type` must be one of them.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Creates a type for the caller's company. Names are unique per company,
ignoring case.

400.description: Empty or longer than 255 characters

403.description: Caller is not an admin

409.description: A type with this name exists

delete.description:
Deletes a type no live stone uses. When stones still use it, answers 409
with those stones; delete or retype them first.

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such type in the caller's company

patch.description:
Renames the type and sets the new name on every stone of the company that
had the old one.

400.description: Empty or longer than 255 characters

403.description: Caller is not an admin

404.description: No such type in the caller's company

get.description:
Returns every checklist of the caller's company, newest first (ties by
id, highest first), with the installer's name and the result of each
check. The customer's signature is not included; the signed PDF of a
checklist is at `/api/checklist-pdf/{id}` on the web app.

403.description: Caller is not an employee or admin

post.description:
Returns a presigned URL to `PUT` the file to (straight to storage, any
size) and the public URL the file will have. Then pass `url` to the
record's route, e.g. `PUT /v1/stones/{id}` (`image_url`),
`POST /v1/stones/{id}/images` or `POST /v1/deals/{id}/files`; that route
also makes the thumbnail. Inventory folders are for admins; `deals` for
any employee and also takes documents; `emails` for any employee, any
file, and the response has the `token` `POST /v1/emails` asks for.

400.description: Content type not allowed for the folder, or a malformed body

403.description: Caller is not an employee, or not an admin for an inventory folder

503.description: Uploads are not configured on this server

get.summary: Find a company by its subdomain
get.description:
Returns the id of the company whose showroom lives at
`<subdomain>.granite-manager.com`. No session needed.

404.description: No live company has this subdomain

get.description:
Returns the company's displayed stones that are regular stock or have an
available whole slab, by name, with slab counts and retail prices (never
costs). Filters combine with AND; repeat list filters to match any value.
No session needed.

parameters.name: color_id
parameters.description: Only stones tagged with at least one of these colors (color ids).

400.description: A filter has the wrong type

get.summary: Search a company's showroom stones by name
get.description:
Same stones as the showroom list, filtered by name, best matches first
(name starts with it, then contains it as a word). No session needed.

parameters.name: name

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most stones to return, 1 to 50. Default 25.

get.description:
Returns a displayed stone of the company (sold out included). Hidden,

get.summary: List a showroom stone's installed photos
get.description:
